labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Participants must have histologically or cytologically confirmed recurrent or persistent clear cell carcinoma of the ovary (CCOC) or clear cell carcinoma of other gynecologic origin (e.g., endometrial, cervical, vaginal, vulvar, endometriosis-related).
Participants must have received at least one prior platinum-based chemotherapeutic regimen for primary management of disease.

labels.note: Requires clear cell histology; her cervical adenocarcinoma subtype is not specified (as run 19 variant rule), and she is responding to first line.
